title: ग्रामर: is, are, was, were
Grammar: is, are, was, were
Grammar in Use: is, are, was, were

card: आज की बात: is (एक), are (कई या you)। बीती बात: was (एक), were (कई या you)। Today is Monday. Yesterday was Sunday.
Aaj ki baat: is (ek), are (kai ya you). Beeti baat: was (ek), were (kai ya you). Today is Monday. Yesterday was Sunday.
Now: is (one), are (many, or you). Past: was (one), were (many, or you). Today is Monday. Yesterday was Sunday.
